name: Kiryuu Mai
source: Mai is a nun who's always around the church or at the girl's dorm. She's the mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c11967]Sonya[/url]. She's very kind and friendly, very womanly despite having an interesting and original personality. She is the kind of person we love very easily.
